_comment: Composite Firestore indexes, deployed with `firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes`.
Empty at Milestone 0 because no compound queries exist yet. Single-field indexes are
created automatically by Firestore and never need to be listed here.
Per claude/data-model.md, indexes are added when a query actually needs one: the first
run of an unindexed compound query fails with a console link that creates the exact
index, which is then pasted in here so it is reproducible rather than click-only.
